purpose: Fill Morytania regional skilling gaps missing or only thinly represented across progression-enrichment-regional-skilling-2026-07-25, outfits-2026-07-25, and gaps-2026-07-26: Ectofuntus Prayer loop, Port Phasmatys / Canifis hubs, Everlight dig, Sunspear vyre cremation, Darkmeyer Vitur thieving, blood altar RC, blisterwood chain, Morytania legs 1-3 ladder, farming patches, and related permanent tools. Herblore Habitat is Karamja — not claimed here.

policy.region_rule: region_hint marks where the unlock or activity lives in the current planner taxonomy. region_hints marks a cross-region chain. required_regions is only used when both regions are needed for a full stack, not for dual dig-site claims. Quest auto-completion and League-specific overrides must be applied separately.
policy.no_trade_rule: Prioritise unlocks that materially change self-sufficient progression, training throughput, supply access, or tool progression. Do not mirror every shop item.
policy.rate_rule: Do not promote stale XP/hour figures. Training rates belong in training datasets; this file records unlock state and effects.
policy.exclusion_rule: Herblore Habitat is Karamja geography — never attach it to morytania. Salve is undead combat support (not vyres); full combat rows stay in regional-combat enrichment. Existing ids morytania:temple-trekking-skilling-outfits, morytania:ectofuntus-first-age-outfit, and morytania:morytania-legs-4 are not re-emitted here.

activity_additions.name: Ectofuntus Prayer worship
requirements: Access to Port Phasmatys / Ectofuntus (Ghosts Ahoy strongly recommended for ectophial and free city entry)
Bones or demonic ashes plus buckets of slime per worship
Ghostspeak amulet or Morytania legs 3+ to claim ecto-tokens from ghost disciples
unlocks: Four-times bury/scatter Prayer XP per worship (bonemeal or ashes + bucket of slime)
Five ecto-tokens per worship for First age outfit and other ecto-token sinks
On-site bone grinder (auto mode) and Pool of Slime basement
Weathered wall Agility shortcut (58 Agility) shortening slime collection
Robin daily bonemeal + free slime conversion scaling with Morytania legs 2/3/4
activity_additions.notes: Core early/mid ironman Prayer path and permanent ecto-token farm. First age outfit purchases live on morytania:ectofuntus-first-age-outfit (outfits file) — this row is the worship activity itself. Powder of pulverising (Desert whirligig powders) can grind a full inventory of one bone type at once for 30 minutes; that powder is Desert-sourced, not Morytania. First age outfit XP does not apply while worshipping here.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Morytania activity. Pair with Desert powder of pulverising and Forinthry bonecrusher as optional Prayer-stack pressure, not hard multi-region gates.

activity_additions.name: Port Phasmatys skilling hub
requirements: Ghosts Ahoy for free city entry and unlimited ectophial teleports (otherwise 2 ecto-tokens per entry)
unlocks: Bank and charter ship access
Ectofuntus Prayer loop adjacent to the city
Furnace used with Morytania legs 2+ for accelerated regular cannonball smithing (7 ticks to 4 ticks while worn)
Robin for daily bone-to-bonemeal and free slime buckets (scales with legs tier)
Ectophial destination hub for nearby farming patches and fairy ring ALQ
activity_additions.notes: Treat Port Phasmatys as a Prayer / bank / smithing utility node, not only a quest town. Cannonball speed-up is legs-worn and Phasmatys-local. Do not invent GE or XP/hour figures.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Resolve Ghosts Ahoy through Equilibrium auto-quest overlay before treating ectophial entry as manual.

activity_additions.name: Canifis farming and Slayer Tower hub
unlocks: Canifis mushroom patch west of town (disease-free after medium Morytania achievements)
Slayer Tower undead and aberrant tasks near Mazchna
Canifis lodestone, fairy ring CKS, and Kharyrll teleport as access points
Hair of the Dog trapdoor route into Meiyerditch tunnels / blood altar path
Morytania legs 4 when worn: +10% Slayer XP on Slayer Tower task kills (not the tower dungeon)
activity_additions.notes: Mushroom patch is the signature Canifis Farming node; elite legs double mushroom yield at Canifis, Isafdar, and City of Um without doubling XP. Herb/allotment/flower patches for the Morytania farming loop sit near Port Phasmatys (see morytania:phasmatys-farming-patches). Herblore Habitat is Karamja — not this hub.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Morytania. Isafdar mushroom double-yield is a Tirannwn patch that still requires elite Morytania legs ownership.

activity_additions.name: Port Phasmatys farming patches
activity_additions.location: Farming patches south/west of Port Phasmatys (Ectophial / fairy ALQ approach)
unlocks: Allotment, herb, and flower patches on the Morytania side of the Haunted Woods approach
Ectophial as the primary unlimited teleport into the farming loop after Ghosts Ahoy
Fairy ring ALQ as alternate Haunted Woods approach without ectophial

activity_additions.name: Everlight Dig Site
requirements: 42 Archaeology for Everlight invitation
Morytania access (Priest in Peril progress or Paterdomus ghoul route)
unlocks: Everlight excavation hotspots, material caches, and site bank chest / workbench / material storage
Site-specific materials (keramos, white marble, cobalt blue, and related Everlight caches)
Mystery progression including Hallowed Be... and Cup of Nectar for Heightened Senses monolith relic
On-site fishing spots and Everlight porcelain clay mine as incidental gather nodes

activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Morytania Archaeology. Guild chronotes, mattocks, and master outfit remain global Archaeology systems.

activity_additions.name: Sunspear vyre cremation multi-skill training
requirements: The Lord of Vampyrium for base Sunspear (River of Blood for reforged style-switch Sunspear)
Blisterwood weapon access from The Branches of Darkmeyer progression
Morytania legs 4 worn for the +50% Prayer and Firemaking cremation XP boost
unlocks: Automatic vyre corpse cremation on kill with Sunspear (Prayer + Firemaking XP; base 210/150 below 90, 280/200 at 90+ before legs)
+50% Prayer and Firemaking cremation XP while wearing Morytania legs 4
20% chance of shiny-columbarium-key-style loot on auto-cremate (improved by columbarium ring)
Manual columbarium cremation ladder: +10 blisterwood/Sunspear damage per 50 corpses to +100 at 500; Sunspear prayer restore +1% per 50 to +5% at 250
activity_additions.notes: Primary Morytania multi-skill combat training. Auto-cremates do not count toward the 500 manual columbarium cremation damage ladder. Vyres are not Salve targets — use blisterwood/Sunspear, not salve. Seedicide and herb drops make this a passive Farming/Herblore supply method when paired with drop cleaners. Do not ship pre-Aura-Overhaul aura sustain claims.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Morytania Myreque / Darkmeyer quest chain. Resolve quest auto-completion before treating Sunspear as a manual gate.

activity_additions.name: Darkmeyer Thieving and Ring of Vitur
requirements: The Branches of Darkmeyer / Darkmeyer access
High Thieving for vyre consumers (118) and multi-step chests (116) / magic stall (117)
unlocks: Darkmeyer multi-step thieving chests, magic stall, and vyrelord/vyrelady consumer pickpocketing
Ring of Vitur rare drop from those sources
Ring of Vitur worn: +5% Thieving success, +5% Hunter success, prevents vyrewatch aggression
activity_additions.notes: Ring of Vitur is the late Thieving premium for Morytania: global success chance plus Darkmeyer free-slot anti-aggression so master camouflage or other gear can replace House Drakan / Darkmeyer outfits. Drop rates are rare (wiki order ~1/5k chests, ~1/10k stall, ~1/20k consumers before luck); do not invent farm rates. Full method rows live in training-gap-thieving-2026-07-26.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Morytania acquisition. Effects are global once obtained.
